decision_policy: ACCEPT means this exact record is suitable for the stated finite supplied-option execution/development scope after genuine agent inspection. Moderate shared corpus limitations are retained as issues and lower diversity/generalization/shortcut scores. They do not demonstrate an incorrect full target, false operative witness or malformed control. There is no high/critical unresolved defect identified in this inspection. This policy does not follow mechanically from passing assertions.

F.rationale: Fresh full nested execution binds arguments at actual call entry, runs selected branches and caller continuation, and emits the exact complete event/state/checkpoint target. L3 is supported by dependencies, not a high-difficulty or efficacy claim.

R.rationale: Five-event retained prefix has advanced root caller and selected branch; current work initiation/branch condition is false but retained r=3 is consumed by pending add y r. The exact suffix must retain the prior selection and copy rather than re-enter or recompute bindings.

T.rationale: Restart from the current checkpoint state executes the root anew. Replaying already committed add effects and rebinding root argument yields a materially different complete final state in every family; mode alone does not supply that state or trace.

P.rationale: Budget1 commits pending add y retained-r, emits one effect event and pauses with a nonterminal checkpoint. L3 reflects grammar/history/frame validation and retained copy/selection dependencies even though only one new effect is requested. Budget-status regularity is a moderate corpus shortcut.

U.rationale: Six-event prefix is the actual checkpoint after P; its retained branch cursor advances exactly one operation and suffix completes to F/R final state without replaying P. Exact history and typed frame equality are material.

A.rationale: Entry changes positive root argument from reg x to const3 only; initiation remains true. Every family has actual non-enter effect/branch/return projection and final-state differences, so binding evidence is causal rather than an inert enter-event copy.

I.rationale: Const0 root argument fails the decisive p>=1 initiation atom before any effect, after one enter event. The actual explanation names that boundary and L2 is conservative. This is a narrow negative control, not demonstration of nested continuation skill.

S.rationale: Only root success predicate is changed to x>=actual F final-x+1; F effects and final state are retained while the final return fails success. Full execution is needed for the complete target; numeric threshold vocabulary creates measured partial status predictability.

X.rationale: Exactly one active saved binding, cursor or state field is tampered. Reconstructing the supplied successful prefix invalidates it before any new effect with no output checkpoint. L3 concerns prefix/copy/cursor validation; some local discrepancies are discoverable by the shallow status baseline.
